matches.text: # Applies the rows of scenarios/moba/abilities_688g.tsv whose status is "applied" to abilities.osd.
# Applies scenarios/moba/creeps_688g.tsv to the neutral and Roshan unit lines of units.osd, and drops the
# Applies scenarios/moba/heroes_688g.tsv to units_heroes.osd and the hero lines of attr_rules.txt.
// (js/client inside it); the default is ../oscraft-site next to the repo. Only js/client and scenarios/moba are watched.
# Each pack builds its map image into its own directory (manifest.image); the site serves the packs from scenarios/.
for f in js/client/editor.html js/client/play.html js/client/play.js js/client/pack_load.js scenarios/moba/manifest.json scenarios/moba/moba.osdt js/client/pkg/
# bin/oscraft-lsp, js/client (the page, its wire/ and vendor/ and the wasm package in js/client/pkg), scenarios/moba and
# scenarios/duel-routes with their map images, mods/, VERSION and MANIFEST.sha256.
for s in moba duel-routes; do cp -R "scenarios/$s" "$stage/scenarios/$s"; done
[ -s scenarios/moba/moba.osdt ] || fail "scenarios/moba/moba.osdt (the moba map image) is missing or empty"
[ -s scenarios/duel-routes/duel-routes.osdt ] || fail "scenarios/duel-routes/duel-routes.osdt is missing or empty"
[ -d scenarios/moba/assets/models ] && [ -n "$(ls -A scenarios/moba/assets/models)" ] || fail "scenarios/moba/assets/models is missing or empty"
